official_migration_sources.locator: Removal of prior version deprecations; GH 52364
official_migration_sources.fact: pandas 3.0.0 removes DataFrame.applymap, Styler.applymap and Styler.applymap_index.
DataFrame.applymap was deprecated and renamed to DataFrame.map; map applies a scalar function elementwise.
